bools.name: dgsHoldingsAreT39Property
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the holdings are the property results gained on Table 39: Ancestry

bools.name: dgsNpcAutoOwnership
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the holdings are automatically owned by some NPC of the family

bools.name: dgsNeverPcOwnedAtStart
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): never owned by a player character or his siblings at the start of the career

bools.name: dgsFirstHoldingToHead
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the first ancestral holding is automatically held by the head of the family

bools.name: dgsRemainderDiceAssignment
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): any remaining holdings are assigned by random dice roll to NPCs on the Head of Family and Father rows of the Family Chart

bools.name: dgsPositionMethodUsed
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the assignment uses the method described for determining the character's position in the family

bools.name: dgsOverflowToHead
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): a die roll greater than the number of spaces gives the property to the head of the family

bools.name: dgsNoAutomaticPcUse
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): clan ownership does not automatically grant the player character use of the property

bools.name: dgsOwnerPermissionRequired
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the player character must request permission of the NPC owner

bools.name: dgsReactionRollStillMade
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): a reaction roll must still be made

bools.name: dgsDmMayRefuse
bools.comment: Ancestral holdings prose (capture pp. 67-68): the DM can refuse requests not in keeping with his campaign
